stem: End-of-line plants consistently remain drier than plants near the irrigation source. What is the strongest first investigation?
choices: Check pressure, emitter uniformity and delivery distribution before diagnosing the pattern as nutrition
Increase fertilizer only at the dry end
Assume cultivar differences explain the entire row pattern
Ignore irrigation because all emitters are the same model
rationale: A spatial irrigation pattern should be evaluated as a distribution problem before being relabeled as a nutrient issue.
